title: Visitors can register an account; invalid or taken data is refused
Users log in with email and password and get a session; failures do not reveal which part was wrong
description: Login with e-mail and password returns a session token. A failed login gives the same message for an unknown user and a wrong password.

title: Logging out ends the session token
Users can change their password; the old password stops working
Users can view and update their profile; the phone number is validated
Users can create notes in the categories Home, Work and Personal; invalid notes are refused
description: A note has a title (4-100 characters), a description (4-1000) and one of the categories Home, Work, Personal.

title: Users can edit notes and mark them completed; progress is shown
Users can delete notes after confirming
Users can only see and change their own notes
description: No user can read, change or delete another user's notes; requests without a valid token are rejected.

title: Users can search notes and filter them by category
Users can reset a forgotten password by email
Notes created offline are saved when the connection returns
Customers can browse the product catalogue and filter it by category
Customers can search products; no match is stated clearly
Customers can sort products by name and price
Product details match the catalogue and products can be added to the cart in any quantity
Customers can log in and out; wrong or missing credentials are reported
description: Customers sign in and out; wrong or missing credentials show a message per field.

title: Customers can check out and place an order with correct totals; guests are asked to sign in
description: Logged-in customers can order; line prices and the total add up; guests are asked to sign in at checkout.

title: The shop stays usable when the product API fails or returns nothing
Customers can pay by credit card
description: Payment by credit card through the payment provider, including 3-D Secure.

title: Customers can download an invoice as PDF
Checkout meets WCAG 2.2 AA
Shoppers can log in and out; locked-out and invalid users see the right error
description: Standard users log in; locked-out and invalid users see the matching error message.

title: The inventory lists all products and can be sorted
The cart keeps added products and its badge follows changes
Shoppers can buy products; totals include 8 % tax and customer details are required
description: Two products can be bought; the overview adds 8 % tax; first name, last name and postal code are required.

title: The API issues tokens and protects the current-user endpoint
The product API supports read, search, paging, field selection and changes
The cart API returns a user's carts with correct line totals
The shop is usable on a phone-sized screen
Staff sign in with a role; viewers can read but not change; failures reveal nothing
description: Admins and viewers sign in with their role; viewers can read but not change; failed sign-ins do not reveal which part was wrong.

title: Every request can be traced by the caller's request id
Admins can create, edit, search and delete customers; every invalid field is reported
Orders compute totals, reserve and release stock and follow the allowed status flow
description: Placing an order computes the totals and reserves stock; cancelling gives it back; the status follows the allowed flow.

title: Admins manage the product catalogue; deleting deactivates instead of removing
Admins manage user accounts and roles
Data changed through the UI or API is stored exactly and consistently
description: Changes made in the UI or through the API are stored exactly as sent and are visible in both.

title: Passwords are stored hashed and salted
description: Passwords are stored as salted hashes, never in clear text.

title: Admins can export orders as CSV
Changes made by admins are written to an audit log
The order list answers within 2 s for 50 concurrent admins
Admins must confirm sign-in with a second factor
description: Admins confirm every sign-in with a second factor (authenticator app).
